appearance_scope: independent player/team participation identities; no box-minute repair or reconstructed floor-time certification

denominators.limitations: Provider tracking/credit allocation is not independently reconstructed. Pair credits and help fields need not conserve box totals. No causal impact, nearest-defender or WOWY claim.
denominators.matchup_seconds: source matchup_minutes_sort seconds; display MM:SS is not arithmetic input
denominators.partial_possessions: provider fractional matchup credits, not ordinary team possessions
denominators.percentage_defender_total_time: provider share of defender floor time
denominators.percentage_offensive_total_time: provider share of offensive player floor time
denominators.percentage_total_time_both_on: provider share of shared floor time
denominators.shooting_percentage: sum source makes / sum corresponding source attempts; zero attempts is unknown

row_identity: retained SHA-256 plus 1-based CSV data-row number; every decoded field hashed as canonical JSON, original CSV bytes retained
